quests.instruction: What is the third letter of raccoon? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Point to each letter with your finger, starting on the left.
quests.explanation: The third letter of raccoon is C.
quests.funFact: At the end of a word, c and k team up as 'ck' in duck and clock, and they say one 'k' sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the letter c in it?
quests.hint: Spell each word in your head and look for a small open curve.
quests.explanation: duck is spelled d-u-c-k, so it has c. hippo and dress do not.
quests.funFact: Lowercase c is just a smaller version of capital C.

quests.instruction: Look at volcano. Which letter is at the very end?
quests.hint: volcano has 7 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: volcano is spelled v-o-l-c-a-n-o. Its last letter is O.
quests.funFact: O is letter number 15 of the 26 letters, with 14 letters before it and 11 after it.

quests.instruction: Look at soap. Which letter does not belong to it?
quests.hint: Find the two letters you can see in the word. The third is the answer.
quests.explanation: soap is spelled s-o-a-p. There is no i in it.
quests.funFact: I is a vowel. It can say 'ih' as in pig, or 'eye' as in bike.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the second letter in whale?
quests.hint: Point to each letter with your finger, starting on the left.
quests.explanation: whale is spelled w-h-a-l-e. Its second letter is H.
quests.funFact: H says 'huh', a soft puff of breath.

quests.instruction: Which word has e as its last letter?
quests.hint: Look at the far right of each word. That is where words end.
quests.explanation: horse ends with e. worm ends with m and tennis ends with s.
quests.funFact: E is letter number 5 of the 26 letters, with 4 letters before it and 21 after it.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the third letter in llama?
quests.hint: llama has 5 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: In llama, a is the third letter.
quests.funFact: A can say its name, as in cake, or a short sound, as in cat.

quests.instruction: Look at fox. Which letter is hiding in it?
quests.hint: Spell fox out loud: f-o-x.
quests.explanation: fox is spelled f-o-x, so o is in it. n and q are not.
quests.funFact: Octopus, otter and ox begin with the short o sound.

quests.instruction: Which word contains m?
quests.hint: The letter m can be at the start, the middle or the end.
quests.explanation: alarm is spelled a-l-a-r-m, so it has m. yawn and penguin do not.
quests.funFact: Milk, map and mouse all begin with M.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the fourth letter in rooster?
quests.hint: Say rooster one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: The fourth letter of rooster is s.
quests.funFact: S and Z are made the same way in your mouth, but for Z your voice buzzes.

quests.instruction: Two of these letters are in spider. Which one is missing?
quests.hint: Spell spider: s-p-i-d-e-r. Then check each choice.
quests.explanation: spider is spelled s-p-i-d-e-r. There is no o in it.
quests.funFact: The word 'oh' is spelled just like the letter's name, o-h.

quests.instruction: Which word ends with the letter t?
quests.hint: Look at the far right of each word. That is where words end.
quests.explanation: paint ends with t. tree ends with e and lock ends with k.
quests.funFact: T begins 'the', the most-used word in English.

quests.instruction: One word has p hiding inside. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Say each word slowly, one letter at a time.
quests.explanation: grapes is spelled g-r-a-p-e-s, so it has p. quiet and diamond do not.
quests.funFact: P is letter number 16 of the 26 letters, with 15 letters before it and 10 after it.

quests.instruction: What is the third letter of rain? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Say rain one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: In rain, i is the third letter.
quests.funFact: In light and night, the letters 'igh' say 'eye'.

quests.instruction: Find the letter that says 'guh'.
quests.hint: The back of your tongue lifts up.
quests.explanation: The letter g says 'guh'.
quests.funFact: Gorilla, goat and grapes all begin with the hard G sound.

quests.instruction: What is the fourth letter of banana? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Spell banana slowly: b-a-n-a-n-a.
quests.explanation: banana is spelled b-a-n-a-n-a. Its fourth letter is A.
quests.funFact: A capital A looks like a little tent with a bar across the middle.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with j and ends with p?
quests.hint: Check two things for each word: the first letter and the last letter.
quests.explanation: jump starts with j and ends with p. jacket has the wrong ending, and laptop has the wrong start.
quests.funFact: Capital J is a hook that curves to the left at the bottom.

quests.instruction: Which letter can you find in the word pie?
quests.hint: Check each letter against the word, one at a time.
quests.explanation: pie is spelled p-i-e, so E is in it. K and L are not.
quests.funFact: The word 'the' is one of the most-used words in English, and it ends with an e.

quests.instruction: Find the word that starts with t and finishes with k.
quests.hint: One word has the right start but the wrong end, and one has the right end but the wrong start.
quests.explanation: truck starts with t and ends with k. train has the wrong ending, and lock has the wrong start.
quests.funFact: The letters 'th' say a new sound, as in thumb and this.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the third letter in radio?
quests.hint: Say radio one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: The third letter of radio is d.
quests.funFact: Capital D has a straight back and one big curve.

quests.instruction: Which letter is NOT in the word jeans?
quests.hint: Spell jeans: j-e-a-n-s. Then check each choice.
quests.explanation: jeans is spelled j-e-a-n-s. There is no H in it.
quests.funFact: H teams up with other letters in sh, ch and th to make new sounds.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses the letter y.
quests.hint: The letter y can be at the start, the middle or the end.
quests.explanation: eye is spelled e-y-e, so it has y. queen and house do not.
quests.funFact: Yes, you and yellow all begin with the 'yuh' sound.

quests.instruction: What is the fourth letter of scarf? Count from the left.
quests.hint: scarf has 5 letters. Count them from the left, one finger per letter.
quests.explanation: The fourth letter of scarf is r.
quests.funFact: Lowercase r is a short stick with a little curl.

quests.instruction: Find the word that finishes with r.
quests.hint: Look at the far right of each word. That is where words end.
quests.explanation: pear ends with r. mouse ends with e and owl ends with l.
quests.funFact: The name 'ar' sounds like the first part of art.

quests.instruction: The word starts with s and ends with a. Which word is it?
quests.hint: Check two things for each word: the first letter and the last letter.
quests.explanation: sofa starts with s and ends with a. ship has the wrong ending, and koala has the wrong start.
quests.funFact: S can also say 'zzz', as in dogs and toys.

quests.instruction: Look at zap. Which letter does not belong to it?
quests.hint: Find the two letters you can see in the word. The third is the answer.
quests.explanation: zap is spelled z-a-p. There is no B in it.
quests.funFact: B is letter number 2 of the 26 letters, with 1 letters before it and 24 after it.

quests.instruction: What is the second letter of tub? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Say tub one letter at a time and keep your place.
quests.explanation: tub is spelled t-u-b. Its second letter is U.
quests.funFact: U is letter number 21 of the 26 letters, with 20 letters before it and 5 after it.

quests.instruction: What is the third letter of lion? Count from the left.
quests.hint: Spell lion slowly: l-i-o-n.
quests.explanation: In lion, O is the third letter.
quests.funFact: In XOXO, X stands for a kiss and O stands for a hug.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with t and ends with i?
quests.hint: One word has the right start but the wrong end, and one has the right end but the wrong start.
quests.explanation: taxi starts with t and ends with i. tulip has the wrong ending, and kiwi has the wrong start.
quests.funFact: Tent, taxi and tooth all begin with T.

quests.instruction: One word has k hiding inside. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Spell each word in your head and look for a tall stick with a small arrow on its right.
quests.explanation: joker is spelled j-o-k-e-r, so it has k. bat and box do not.
quests.funFact: A kangaroo and a koala both begin with K, and both live in Australia.
